answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 151205 Country: Bangladesh Title: Use of Zakat Money Question: Is it permissible to collect and use zakah money to establish (buy a house) and maintain an institute exclusively involved in teaching and preaching Quran (correcting Quran recitation, teaching Arabic to understand Quran, seminar on Quranic topics)? Answer ID: 151205 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 825/776/SD=9/1438) It is mandatory to give the zakah amount in the complete possession of some poor and needy ones as zakah will not be paid except it. Hence in the question mentioned above it is not lawful to erect building by collecting zakah money and make it an institution and impart the education of Quran there. Zakah shall not be paid in this way. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
